title: AI Terminal
description: Provider settings for AI Terminal (Agent Workspace).

apiProtocol.title: API Protocol
apiProtocol.description: Wire protocol used to call the provider endpoint. Supported values: anthropic-messages and openai-completions.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL for the selected protocol, for example https://api.anthropic.com for anthropic-messages or an OpenAI-compatible relay endpoint for openai-completions.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id sent to the configured provider for the selected protocol.

token.title: API Token
token.description: API token or key sent to the configured provider. Stored in server-side JupyterLab user settings and shown in this Settings UI.

contextWindow.title: Context Window
contextWindow.description: Declared context window in input tokens for the configured model. This is configuration metadata, not a measurement of any model's real capacity. Must be a positive integer. Takes effect when the shared runtime next starts.

maxOutputTokens.title: Maximum Output Tokens
maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens allowed for a single model turn. Must be a positive integer and is used as configured, without a narrower implicit cap. Takes effect when the shared runtime next starts.

compactionEnabled.title: Automatic Compaction
compactionEnabled.description: Enable automatic context compaction in the shared runtime. Takes effect when the shared runtime next starts.

compactionThresholdRatio.title: Compaction Threshold Ratio
compactionThresholdRatio.description: Fraction of the usable message budget at which compaction triggers. Must be greater than 0 and at most 1, and greater than the retain ratio. Takes effect when the shared runtime next starts.

compactionRetainRatio.title: Compaction Retain Ratio
compactionRetainRatio.description: Fraction of the message budget kept after compaction. Must be greater than 0, at most 1, and strictly below the threshold ratio. Takes effect when the shared runtime next starts.

compactionHeadroom.title: Compaction Headroom Tokens
compactionHeadroom.description: Tokens reserved below the message budget before compaction may trigger. Must be 0 or more and leave a positive pressure value. Takes effect when the shared runtime next starts.

compactionSummaryMaxTokens.title: Compaction Summary Output Tokens
compactionSummaryMaxTokens.description: Output token budget for the compaction summary. Must be a positive integer. Takes effect when the shared runtime next starts.
